How we help

AI-Enhanced Custom Software Development

We build custom web apps, internal tools, portals, integrations, and workflow systems with an AI-assisted delivery process. AI helps us move faster through discovery, implementation, refactoring, test generation, and documentation while senior engineering keeps the architecture clean and maintainable.

Custom Web Apps Internal Tools Customer Portals Integrations Cloud Architecture

Automated QA with AI Agents

We deploy AI agents that run through your web app like a careful human tester: navigating pages, submitting forms, checking critical workflows, capturing screenshots, and reporting what failed. It is built for teams that need more release confidence without hiring a full QA department.

Smoke Tests Regression Runs User Journey Testing Screenshots & Reports

Business System Integrations

Many custom software projects start because the tools you already use do not connect cleanly. We build APIs, sync jobs, admin screens, and dashboards that move data between systems without manual copy-paste or fragile spreadsheet workarounds.

API Development Data Sync Workflow Tools Dashboards

Critical Flow Test Coverage

We identify the flows that would hurt most if they broke: login, checkout, quote acceptance, booking, payment, admin updates, notifications, file uploads, and reporting. Then we build agent runs that validate those paths before important releases.

Checkout Forms Admin Workflows Notifications

Modernization Without a Rewrite

If your existing app is valuable but hard to change, we can improve it incrementally: clean up fragile code, add missing features, introduce automated tests, and create a safer release process without pausing the business for a full rebuild.

Refactoring Feature Delivery Test Coverage Release Process

Plain-English QA Reporting

Automated QA is only useful when the output is understandable. We configure reports with screenshots, reproduction steps, likely causes, severity notes, and recommendations so owners, developers, and operators can all see what happened.

Screenshots Bug Summaries Release Notes Risk Signals

Release Readiness Checks

Before a launch or deployment, we can run a focused QA pass against the release candidate and give you a practical go/no-go view: what is safe, what is risky, and what should be fixed first.

Pre-Launch QA Regression Checks Risk Review

Ongoing Technical Partnership

After launch, we can stay involved as a senior technical partner: reviewing architecture, improving code quality, expanding QA coverage, resolving production issues, and helping your team make better software decisions.

Code Review Architecture QA Strategy Support

AI Tooling for Your Team

We can also help your internal team adopt AI development and QA tools responsibly: prompt workflows, code review habits, test generation patterns, and guardrails that increase output without creating unreviewed mess.

AI Dev Workflow Prompt Patterns Review Practices Team Enablement
